Aerospace · Structural FEA · Composite Design
Blue Sky Solar Racing — Aerobody Structural Optimization

Developed a Python-based automated optimization pipeline integrating ANSYS ACP and ANSYS Mechanical to iteratively modify composite core layup structures across 100+ simulation runs. Implemented Bayesian optimization to guide design exploration, achieving ~50% structural weight reduction while maintaining deformation constraints. Optimized mold stack-up configurations in CATIA and SolidWorks to further cut material usage by 60%.

Structural FEA · CCUS · Competition Research
Carbon-Seal — Self-Healing Cement for CO₂ Wellbore Storage

A waste-derived self-healing cement (eggshell powder + rice husk ash) for sealing CO₂ leakage in CCUS wellbores, combining experimental characterization with finite element analysis. Pre-cracked specimens were healed under water immersion and tracked by optical microscopy, achieving 75–80% microcrack closure — roughly double conventional cement. A coupled thermo-structural ANSYS model of the wellbore cement sheath (steel casing, cement annulus, formation rock) under downhole loads (35–120°C gradient, 20 MPa injection, 30 MPa confining) gave the lowest von Mises stress and a 27% higher safety factor than the OPC control. Finalist at PETROLIDA 2026.

Gen 13 Spaceframe Chassis — Blue Sky Solar Racing

Current project. Designing a steel-tube spaceframe chassis for the Aurora solar car, targeting sub-21 kg while maintaining structural performance under all load cases. Building parametric CATIA tube-routing models and evaluating them against ANSYS structural simulations across 5 impact and suspension load cases to minimize mass, iterating toward a safety factor above 1.15 to yield and deflection under 25 mm.
